accepted_findings.reachability_rationale: Bundled protobuf parser is build-host Kotlin/lint tooling operating on the checked-out sources and admitted dependencies, not runtime API payloads. Host builds are offline and noninteractive. A malicious source/dependency can still reach parser paths; no fixed compiler release removes these classes. Owner accepts that residual exposure, not a false-positive determination.

Bundled JLine console grep/Telnet modules are build-host tooling. This harness starts noninteractive offline Gradle/Kotlin builds, does not start a JLine Telnet server or execute user-supplied console grep regex, and never packages this compiler in the app runtime. A different build-host invocation could expose the vulnerable features; accepted by the owner, not proven unreachable universally.
